# Nicole Irmo

> Marketing leader. Marketing executive who turns great stories into real revenue, and builds the teams that keep it growing.

Nicole Irmo is a branding nerd who leads marketing and ecommerce for a direct-to-consumer medical supply brand, where she repositioned a 20-year-old product catalog into a brand platform and built the team that sustains it. She previously ran an independent consultancy and led marketing for hospitality and healthcare product brands. She likes complicated categories, and her aim in every role is to leave marketing better than she found it.

Location: Barrington, Illinois. LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/nicoleirmo/

## Articles
- [In AI search, the most-cited brand wins. Here's how we became it.](https://nicoleirmo.com/insights/most-cited-brand-wins/): Rankings measure where you show up. Citations measure whether you're the answer. That difference decided our category.
- [Seven of nine: building a marketing team that stays](https://nicoleirmo.com/insights/hire-seven-of-nine/): One voluntary departure in three and a half years isn't luck. It's a few unglamorous decisions, made on purpose.
- [Story sells: turning a 20-year-old product catalog into a brand](https://nicoleirmo.com/insights/story-sells/): The company had two decades of products and a website. What it didn't have was a story anyone could repeat.
- [Building community in a category where customers never speak in public](https://nicoleirmo.com/insights/community-where-nobody-talks/): Nobody posts about incontinence. We built the company's first owned advocacy programs anyway, and engagement rose 144%.

## Case studies
- [Rebuilt a 20-year-old product catalog as a real brand](https://nicoleirmo.com/work/brand-platform/): +32% organic search, against an industry decline of 2.5% · 15.3% blog conversion, up from 3.1%
- [Became the most-cited brand in the category across AI search](https://nicoleirmo.com/work/ai-search/): 1,291 citations versus 986 for the nearest competitor
- [Built a marketing function from website support up](https://nicoleirmo.com/work/team/): 7 of 9 team members hired, three promoted, one voluntary departure in three and a half years
- [Landed a full Optimizely replatform on time and on budget](https://nicoleirmo.com/work/replatform/): Same day time-to-launch for pages, down from vendor sprint cycles
- [Built community in a category where customers rarely speak up](https://nicoleirmo.com/work/community/): 500 customer stories captured · +144% engagement · 4.47% monthly follower growth
- [Built the owned channels behind 69% of web revenue](https://nicoleirmo.com/work/owned-channels/): 69% of attributed web revenue from owned channels · 2.3× organic search revenue vs. paid
- [Tested the company's first linear TV and CTV](https://nicoleirmo.com/work/broadcast/): <$3 average CPM on the pilot program
- [Rebranded a regional mortgage lender, top to bottom](https://nicoleirmo.com/work/mortgage/): 60 piece marketing library · 2 Cape Fear Home Builders Association 2023 MAX! Awards, for print and web
- [Ran a print media program for Unilever](https://nicoleirmo.com/work/print-program/): Direct retained directly by Unilever
- [Won a design award with a direct marketing brochure](https://nicoleirmo.com/work/brochure/): Award Graphic Design USA 2022 Health + Wellness Design Award
- [Built the Focus Hospitality brand from the pillars up](https://nicoleirmo.com/work/focus-hospitality/): +30% website traffic after the redesign · +$563K from a national hotel brand's launch · 2,800% ROAS on direct mail
- [Integrated an acquired healthcare bedding brand](https://nicoleirmo.com/work/integration/): −$282K marketing spend, with ad engagement up 14% and sales growing year over year
- [Built the company's first integrated marketing strategy](https://nicoleirmo.com/work/foodservice/): +50% online lead conversion · +16% ecommerce sales in six months · +49% Amazon sales

## Key results (current role, a DTC medical supply brand)
- Company revenue $28.6M to $43.8M in under three years; ten consecutive quarters of growth
- Marketplace revenue $5.7M to $14.4M (+154%)
- Most-cited brand in its category in AI-driven search (1,291 citations vs 986)
- Organic search +32% YoY while the industry fell 2.5%; blog conversion 3.1% to 15.3%
- Hired 7 of 9 team members; 3 promoted; one voluntary departure in 3.5 years
